description: Add a task to a room: title, notes, status, ready (whether it is specified well enough for an assistant to finish on its own), assignee, due (YYYY-MM-DD), priority, links [{title, url}], account (a Google Ads customer id, when the task is a piece of work in one of the organization's accounts). A client asking for something in the room belongs here: the task is what an expert reviews and closes, by hand or by applying a change an agent drafted for it. -- MakeHybrid API plan, POST /rooms/{id}/tasks, group rooms.

id.description: Value for the {id} segment of /rooms/{id}/tasks. Required; pass it raw (it is URL-escaped for you).

query.description: Optional query-string parameters, e.g. {"limit":"20","cursor":"..."}. Values are coerced to strings.
